discovery.en: Deliberately looking for rejection might be an extreme way to become more confident, but it can lead to surprising discoveries.
discovery.zh: 故意寻求拒绝也许是建立自信的一种极端方式，但它可能会带来令人惊喜的发现。

diet.en: There was nothing unusual or inferior about the British diet.
diet.zh: 英国人的饮食没有什么不寻常或低人一等的。

discover.en: It’s often traced to soldiers from the USA arriving in Britain after World War II and discovering the food was not tasty, the food was poor quality.
discover.zh: 它通常被追溯到第二次世界大战后抵达英国的美国士兵，他们发现食物不好吃，食物质量很差。

dispute.en: Its exact origins are disputed , but it’s generally understood to be a product of the British Indian restaurant tradition.
dispute.zh: 它的具体起源备受争议，但人们普遍理解它是英国印度餐馆传统的产物。

distinctly.en: Italian immigrants moved to the US, transformed the dish pizza to a new style, created New York and Chicago pizzas that are now distinctly American.
distinctly.zh: 意大利移民搬到美国，将披萨这道菜转变为一种新的风格，创造了现在明显具有美国特色的纽约和芝加哥披萨。

disappear.en: The stereotype of British food being bad hasn’t disappeared, but Britain has a much more sophisticated and diverse food culture now.
disappear.zh: 英国食物不好的刻板印象并没有消失，但英国现在拥有更加精致和多元的饮食文化。

diverse.en: The stereotype of British food being bad hasn’t disappeared, but Britain has a much more sophisticated and diverse food culture now.
diverse.zh: 英国食物不好的刻板印象并没有消失，但英国现在拥有更加精致和多元的饮食文化。
